pricing_model.title: Linear Pricing 2026: Plans, Per-User Costs
pricing_model.text: Linear uses a simple per-seat model with four tiers: a Free plan for small teams, a paid Basic plan, a Business plan for scaling organizations, and custom Enterprise pricing. Plans are billed per user, with a discount for annual billing.

pricing_model.title: Pricing – Linear
pricing_model.text: Free $0 Free for everyone. Unlimited members. 2 teams. 250 issues. Basic $10 per user/month. Billed yearly. All Free features + 5 teams. Unlimited issues. File uploads. Admin roles. Business $16 per user/month. Billed yearly. All Basic features + Unlimited teams. Private teams. Guest accounts. Triage Intelligence. Enterprise Custom. Annual billing only. All Business features + SAML and SCIM. Priority support.

feature_tree.title: Features – Linear
feature_tree.text: The system for modern product development. Linear streamlines work across the entire development cycle, from roadmap to release. Planning: Set the product direction with projects and initiatives. Building: Make progress with issue tracking and cycle planning. Streamline product development with AI-powered workflows and agents. Instant analytics for any stream of work. Move product work forward from anywhere. Build what customers actually want with Customer Requests. Turn workplace requests into actionable issues with Linear Asks.

user_persona.title: Linear – The product development system for teams and agents
user_persona.text: The product development system for teams and agents. Purpose-built for planning and building products. Designed for the AI era. Purpose-built for modern teams with AI workflows at its core. 33,000 product teams. From ambitious startups to major enterprises. Designed for workflows shared by humans and agents. From drafting PRDs to pushing PRs. "Linear is excellent, just excellent. It has the right opinions for fast moving teams." — Kaz Nejatian, Opendoor. "Our speed is intense and Linear helps us be action biased." — Nik Koblov, Ramp.
